t: Three conditionals, each answered by the same verb
a: مَنْ يَسْتَعِفَّ يُعِفُّهُ اللَّهُ، وَمَنْ يَتَصَبَّرْ يُصَبِّرْهُ اللَّهُ، وَمَنْ يَسْتَغْنِ يُغْنِهِ اللَّهُ، وَلَنْ تُعْطَوْا عَطَاءً خَيْرًا وَأَوْسَعَ مِنَ الصَّبْرِ
p: Man yastaʿiffa yuʿiffhu-Llāh, wa man yataṣabbar yuṣabbirhu-Llāh, wa man yastaghni yughnihi-Llāh. Wa lan tuʿṭaw ʿaṭāʾan khayran wa awsaʿa mina-ṣ-ṣabr
m: Whoever seeks to hold back, Allah keeps him back. Whoever tries to be patient, Allah gives him patience. Whoever seeks to be self sufficient, Allah makes him self sufficient. And you will never be given a gift better or wider than patience.
